meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一件大活拆给多个 AI 小组分头做,并盯着它们回报进度直到收尾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时有好几个 AI 任务在跑,需要有人分派、盯梢并汇总结果
copy.tagline_en: Split a big job across several AI workers and supervise them through to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run several AI tasks at once and need someone to dispatch, track and merge results

howto.what: 协调多个受监督的 Orca worker:发送线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、派发任务、等待 worker 完成或升级、编排任务 DAG 与决策门,并把工作拆给多个 agent。完整所有权交接(hand off)不归它,由 orca-cli 技能处理。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多 agent 协调时接管:发送线程消息、派发任务、编排任务 DAG 等。若只是要把工作整体交给另一个 agent,则应改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 把这项工作拆成三个任务,交给不同 worker 并行执行。
say.note: 会通过 Orca 派发任务并跟踪状态。

say.text: 等所有 worker 完成后,把结果汇总给我。
say.note: 会等待 worker_done 再回报。

say.text: 这里加一个决策门,条件满足再走下一步。
say.note: 会阻塞到决策门条件成立。

howto.what_en: Coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done and escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you need structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, task dispatch, waiting for worker results, or coordinating a task DAG.

say_en.text: Split this work into three tasks and run them on different workers.
say_en.note: Dispatches tasks through Orca and tracks them.

say_en.text: Wait for all workers to finish, then summarize the results.
say_en.note: Waits on worker_done before reporting back.

say_en.text: Add a decision gate here; only proceed when it passes.
say_en.note: Blocks until the gate condition is met.
